title: Free Up Gmail Storage Before You Pay for More
summary: Archive your biggest emails to Drive, drop marketing lists you never read, and clear bulk senders you approve, so a full inbox does not push you onto a bigger storage plan.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes your inbox is near its storage limit; the value is time saved and an upgrade put off, with you approving every trash.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Delay or skip a storage upgrade you may not need.
Less time digging for real customer mail.
who_its_for: Owners close to their Gmail storage limit.
Small teams with years of attachments in one inbox.

steps.name: Gmail Cleanup Chief of Staff

steps: See which senders and large emails use the most space.
Archive the biggest emails to Drive and check the files.
Drop marketing lists you never read.
guardrails: Nothing is trashed without your yes.
Keep legal and tax originals in place if you must keep them.
